violations.description: CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not to be further cooked. Observed ground beef stored above rice and vegetables in drawer style coolers in cook line. Observed eggs stored above cases of vegetables in walk in cooler.
COOLING OF POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (5 pts): Rice noted not being adequately cooled to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria.
SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the main kitchen dish machine.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of chicken was noted not being properly dated for disposition. Open bags of chicken not date marked in prep top cooler and in walk in cooler. In pizza prep top cooler noted but not limited to bags of shredded cheese crumbled meats not date marked.

FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Reachin cooler interior not properly maintained. Condensate collects in the bottom of the pizza prep top cooler utilizing rags to absorb condensate. Food containers and food storage bags are being stored on the rags potentially contaminating storage containers. Food equipment not properly maintained. Observed food debris remaining on clean manual vegetable slicers.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Vent covers in kitchen noted with dust and debris build up through out kitchen and rear prep areas.

COOKING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (5 pts): Potentially hazardous food noted not being adequately reheated. Food items observed such as soups sauces and other hot held food items are not being reheated within the alloted amount of time.
SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the dish machine.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of cheese and chicken wings was noted not being properly dated for disposition in the prep top coolers and the prep line upright cooler.

EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Employee noted handling food contact items with contaminated hands. Observed employee wipe face with paper towel rinse food off of dirty dishes and then procceded to unload clean dishes without proper handwashing between dirty to clean tasks.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of shredded/crumbled cheese in rear 2 door upright and sauces/salsas in the walk in cooler was noted not being properly dated for disposition.
DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test kit noted not provided for quat sanitizer.
